about: Rock and soil chemistry: Mars (rover and meteorite) vs Earth materials used to stand in for it. Oxide wt%, total iron as FeO (FeOT). Satellites do not give per-pixel element chemistry of Earth, so this panel uses lab and rover samples only, tagged by kind.
similarity: Mean absolute difference over the 9 compared oxides, in wt%, vs Rocknest. Lower is closer.

materials.name: Rocknest soil, Gale crater
materials.source: Curiosity APXS bulk, Achilles et al. (2017) Table 6, as reprinted in Cannon et al. (2019) Icarus 317, 470, Table 2
materials.note: The reference basaltic soil of Mars: wind mixes sand and dust planet-wide, so Rocknest stands for basaltic soil generally (Cannon et al. 2019).

materials.name: Shergotty meteorite (Martian basalt)
materials.source: Dreibus et al. (1982), as compiled in Meyer, C. (2012) Martian Meteorite Compendium, NASA JSC, Shergotty, Table 1a (whole rock; FeO is total iron; the table's 'P2O3' row read as P2O5)
materials.note: A piece of Mars that fell at Sherghati, India, on 25 August 1865. It is a basalt, like most of the Martian crust.

materials.name: Hawaiian basalt (USGS BHVO-2)
materials.source: USGS Certificate of Analysis, Basalt, Hawaiian Volcanic Observatory, BHVO-2 (1998), recommended values; FeOT = 0.8998 x Fe2O3T 12.3
materials.note: Kilauea lava from 1919. A standard Earth basalt.

materials.name: JSC Mars-1 simulant (Mauna Kea tephra)
materials.source: NASA MSFC presentation (Carpenter, Sibille et al.), JSC Mars-1 chemistry table; FeOT = 0.8998 x Fe2O3 15.6 (assumed total iron)
materials.note: Weathered volcanic ash from the Pu'u Nene cinder cone, Mauna Kea, Hawaii. NASA's classic Mars soil stand-in.

materials.name: MGS-1 simulant (mixed from Earth minerals)
materials.source: Cannon et al. (2019) Icarus 317, 470, Table 2, MGS-1 prototype (XRF)
materials.note: Built to copy Rocknest: Earth plagioclase, pyroxene, olivine, basaltic glass and salts mixed to a recipe.

rocknest.source: CheMin XRD, Achilles et al. (2017) Table 1, as reprinted in Cannon et al. (2019) Table 1
